name: crypte-sprite
description: Creates a Crypt sprite: grid plan, drawing, sheet regeneration and tests.

steps.prompt: Propose the plan of a sprite for: {{creature}}. Choose the screen (creatures 32x32, hub, or the Haunt game), the file slug, and the complete grid letter by letter with the palette of the README (W S U K O o R r G g P p Y y N, . transparent). Do not edit any source file. Write the plan in .kiro/workflow-output/sprite-plan.md. End with send_message severity success and the plan as a summary. Answer in English.
